hook: How was the *listening device* installed in OpenAI?
caption:
An OpenAI engineer has been charged with hiding a recording device inside the company's San Francisco office.

The FBI says the thumb-sized device was wrapped in toilet paper and plugged into a USB port behind the TV in an executive conference room. OpenAI found it on September 30, then set up a camera that caught him checking behind the TV.

OpenAI says it has no sign that model weights, source code or customer data were taken, and the employee was fired. He faces up to five years in prison if convicted.
